what: confluence zones on the close: two or more named levels within 1% of each other — reviewed lines by the Lab's own labels, and the 21-, 50-, 100- and 200-day averages
rule: two or more levels all within 1% of each other (top no more than 1% above bottom); closest neighbours joined first
two_sources: members come from at least two sources: two source timeframes, or a line and a moving average
